rules:
• One event will be chosen by the Club Captain for the Club Champs.
  • Usually, the event will be a Regional Event within East Anglia and all members are encouraged to compete.
  • Age class to course mapping is consistent with the EA league.
  • Positions in the championship table are based on calculated running pace, i.e. actual pace in minutes per kilometre adjusted by a "fiddle factor" which takes age into account.
  • The designated courses and fiddle factors for each age class are given in the table below. Fiddle factors are taken from 2025 BOF rules.
